versions.changelog:
- Removed three backup script files: auto_poster.py, data_tracker.py, and reply_bot.py.
- No changes to skill features or documentation.
- Version number in SKILL.md remains at 1.0.2 despite file removals.

- Major update: Transitioned skill from an automated content matrix system to a content operation template and strategy pack.
- Updated description, name, and feature list to focus on content templates, scheduling advice, and Hong Kong–localized strategies.
- Added new template and guideline modules (content templates, posting schedule, data analysis tips).
- Removed automation scripts from main scripts/ directory; backups moved to scripts_backup/.
- Reduced technical automation content in favor of ready-to-use example templates and strategy explanations.

- Major update: Skill description and documentation fully rewritten for clarity, detail, and local relevance.
- Highlights Hong Kong market focus, key platforms (小红书, 抖音, 公众号), and monetization workflows.
- Adds installation instructions and practical use cases, specifying required skills and modules.
- Introduces detailed feature breakdown including topic selection, automated publishing, analytics, and profit examples.
- Outlines earning projections and real-world impact for target users.

- Initial release of hk-cn-content-matrix.
- Automates generation, publishing, and monitoring of Chinese social media content across platforms like Xiaohongshu, X (Twitter), Douyin, and Instagram.
- Features AI-driven content creation (Mandarin, Cantonese, Traditional Chinese), trending topic tracking, and SEO optimization.
- Includes content scheduling, data analytics, and automated workflows for posting and engagement.
- Provides tools and scripts for post generation, auto-reply, data tracking, and popular hashtag use.
- Offers flexible pricing for single/multi-account and enterprise scenarios.
